28/* @brief Base class for robot sensors.
29 * Derives from ComponentBase for common lifecycle (validity, actor, destroy).
30 * Each derived sensor keeps its own specialized ComputeSignal signature. */
31// NOLINTNEXTLINE(cppcoreguidelines-virtual-class-destructor)
32class MOCHI_API SensorBase : public ComponentBase {
33 public:
34 /* @brief Reset internal state between episodes, keeping params. Pure virtual so every sensor
35 * states its answer explicitly: a stateful sensor that silently inherited a no-op would leave
36 * stale state alive across a reset, which is only discoverable in the collected data. A sensor
37 * that holds no per-episode state implements this as an empty body. */
38 void Reset() override = 0;
39
40 /* @brief The sensor's pose relative to its parent frame: the associated link's actor for
41 * bot-owned sensors, or the scene root for scene-level / actor-less sensors. aFromB convention
42 * (maps sensor-frame coordinates into the parent frame).
43 * @return Sensor pose relative to its parent frame. */
44 [[nodiscard]] TransformRT const& GetParentFromSensor() const {
45 return _parentFromSensor;
46 }
47
48 /* @brief Set the sensor's pose relative to its parent frame.
49 * @param parentFromSensor The new parent-from-sensor transform (aFromB convention). */
50 void SetParentFromSensor(TransformRT const& parentFromSensor) {
51 _parentFromSensor = parentFromSensor;
52 }
53
54 /* @brief The sensor's pose in world space.
55 * When the sensor is bound to a Mochi @ref Actor, that actor's transform is already
56 * world-resolved by the simulation, so world = actorWorldTransform * parentFromSensor. When the
57 * sensor has no actor (a fusion sensor that consumes other sensors, or a scene sensor standing in
58 * for a scene root that has no Mochi actor), the scene root is the parent: world =
59 * parentFromSensor, i.e. the scene-root-to-world transform is treated as identity (a surrogate
60 * for a real scene-root actor) until scene spawn transforms are supported.
61 * @return Sensor pose in world space. */
62 [[nodiscard]] TransformRT GetWorldTransform() const;
63
64 protected:
65 /* @brief Common sensor constructor archetype: stores the (optionally null) @p actor via
66 * ComponentBase. A null actor is permitted so a sensor can run without a live Mochi body -- e.g.
67 * a fusion sensor that consumes other sensors' outputs and re-emits fused data, mirroring how a
68 * controller can run without an Actor. Sensors that require an actor enforce that themselves. The
69 * @p error argument is retained for archetype/delegation uniformity even though the base no
70 * longer validates the actor. */
71 SensorBase(Actor* actor, [[maybe_unused]] superdex::Error& error) : ComponentBase(actor) {}
72
73 /* The sensor's pose relative to its parent frame (see GetParentFromSensor). */
74 TransformRT _parentFromSensor;
75
76 ~SensorBase() override;
77};
